description:
A powerful app manager for efficiently managing various apps and permissions Buge App Manager is a modern, lightweight and privacy‑friendly app manager that helps you inspect, manage and control applications installed on your device. You can use Buge App Manager without root access, and optionally enable advanced features through Shizuku (https://shizuku.rikka.app/download/) Dhizuku (https://github.com/iamr0s/Dhizuku) or ROOT. Features
  • View detailed app information — package name, version, permissions, install source and more
  • Export installed apps as APK files for backup or sharing
  • Manage app permissions to improve privacy and security
  • Clear cache and view storage usage
  • Uninstall apps easily (system app removal requires Shizuku)
  • Modern, clean and minimal UI
  • No ads, no analytics, fully open source
Notes
  • Some advanced operations require Shizuku Dhizuku or ROOT
  • Designed to be safe, but removing essential system apps may still cause issues after reboot
Source code: https://github.com/BugeStudioTeam/Buge-App-Manager
